requirements.quote:
These delays are decoded from the ACK
   Delay field of ACK frames
requirements.condition: When obtaining the peer-reported acknowledgment delay used to adjust an RTT sample
requirements.required_behavior: Decode the delay from the ACK Delay field of the ACK frame.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation test can construct ACK frames with known encoded ACK Delay values and observe the delay value supplied to RTT adjustment.

requirements.quote:
the endpoint SHOULD ignore
   max_ack_delay until the handshake is confirmed
requirements.condition: Before handshake confirmation when adjusting RTT using a peer-reported acknowledgment delay
requirements.required_behavior: Ignore the peer's max_ack_delay limit, unless the implementation has a documented reason to depart from this recommendation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not routinely cap the reported acknowledgment delay at max_ack_delay before handshake confirmation.
requirements.why_checkable: A pre-confirmation ACK reporting a delay above max_ack_delay can reveal whether the estimator caps the delay.

requirements.quote:
prior to handshake confirmation, an endpoint
   MAY ignore RTT samples if adjusting the RTT sample for acknowledgment
   delay causes the sample to be less than the min_rtt.
requirements.condition: Before handshake confirmation, when acknowledgment-delay adjustment would make an RTT sample less than min_rtt
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to discard that RTT sample.
requirements.why_checkable: A crafted pre-confirmation sample and ACK delay can exercise the optional sample-discard branch and verify that discarding is accepted behavior.

requirements.quote:
these extra delays are considered effectively part of path
   delay and incorporated into the RTT estimate.
requirements.condition: After handshake confirmation, when a peer reports acknowledgment delay greater than max_ack_delay
requirements.required_behavior: Retain the portion above max_ack_delay in the adjusted RTT as path delay and incorporate it into the RTT estimate.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not remove the entire reported acknowledgment delay from the RTT sample.
requirements.why_checkable: With latest_rtt and a reported delay above max_ack_delay fixed, the resulting adjusted RTT and estimator values show whether the excess remained as path delay.

requirements.quote: MAY ignore the acknowledgment delay for Initial packets
requirements.condition: When adjusting an RTT sample obtained from acknowledgment of an Initial packet
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint is permitted to use no peer acknowledgment-delay adjustment for the sample.
requirements.why_checkable: An Initial-packet ACK with a nonzero ACK Delay can test whether the optional ignore behavior is implemented.

requirements.quote:
MUST use the lesser of the acknowledgment delay and the peer's
      max_ack_delay after the handshake is confirmed
requirements.condition: After handshake confirmation when selecting the acknowledgment delay for RTT adjustment
requirements.required_behavior: Use min(peer-reported acknowledgment delay, peer max_ack_delay).
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use a delay greater than max_ack_delay for the subtraction.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests on reported delays below, equal to, and above max_ack_delay can verify the selected adjustment value.

requirements.quote:
MUST NOT subtract the acknowledgment delay from the RTT sample if
      the resulting value is smaller than the min_rtt.
requirements.condition: When subtracting the selected acknowledgment delay from latest_rtt would produce a value smaller than min_rtt
requirements.required_behavior: Leave the RTT sample unadjusted by acknowledgment delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not subtract the acknowledgment delay in this case.
requirements.why_checkable: A sample just below the min_rtt-plus-delay threshold can verify that a peer-reported delay cannot drive the adjusted RTT below min_rtt.

requirements.quote:
an endpoint SHOULD subtract such local delays from its RTT
   sample until the handshake is confirmed.
requirements.condition: Before handshake confirmation, when local ACK processing was postponed because the corresponding decryption keys were unavailable
requirements.required_behavior: Subtract the attributable local processing delay from the RTT sample, unless the implementation has a documented reason to depart from this recommendation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not routinely count the attributable local decryption-key wait as network RTT before handshake confirmation.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled delay in making packet-protection keys available can verify whether that local delay is removed from the recorded RTT sample.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint initializes the RTT estimator during connection
   establishment
requirements.condition: During connection establishment
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize the RTT estimator.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave the estimator uninitialized until the first RTT sample.
requirements.why_checkable: Estimator state can be inspected before any RTT sample is received during connection setup.

requirements.quote:
and when the estimator is reset during connection
   migration
requirements.condition: When the RTT estimator is reset during connection migration
requirements.required_behavior: Reinitialize the RTT estimator for the migrated connection path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain the pre-reset estimator state as the initialized state for the new path.
requirements.why_checkable: A migration-triggered estimator reset can be followed by inspecting its newly initialized state.

requirements.quote:
Before any RTT
   samples are available for a new path or when the estimator is reset,
   the estimator is initialized using the initial RTT
requirements.condition: Before any RTT samples are available for a new path, or after the estimator is reset
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize the estimator from the configured initial RTT value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not initialize it from RTT history belonging to a previous path or pre-reset estimator.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can inspect estimator state immediately on a new path and immediately after reset, before supplying a sample.

requirements.quote: smoothed_rtt = kInitialRtt
requirements.condition: When the RTT estimator is initialized using the initial RTT
requirements.required_behavior: Set smoothed_rtt equal to kInitialRtt.
requirements.why_checkable: The initialized smoothed_rtt can be compared directly with the configured kInitialRtt.

requirements.quote: rttvar = kInitialRtt / 2
requirements.condition: When the RTT estimator is initialized using the initial RTT
requirements.required_behavior: Set rttvar equal to one half of kInitialRtt.
requirements.why_checkable: The initialized rttvar can be compared directly with half the configured kInitialRtt.

requirements.quote: RTT samples for the network path are recorded in latest_rtt
requirements.condition: When an RTT sample is obtained for the current network path
requirements.required_behavior: Record the sample in latest_rtt.
requirements.why_checkable: Supplying a known current-path RTT sample allows direct observation of latest_rtt.

requirements.quote:
On the first RTT sample after initialization, the
   estimator is reset using that sample.
requirements.condition: On the first RTT sample after estimator initialization
requirements.required_behavior: Reset the estimator from that first sample so that previous or initial estimator history does not contribute.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not blend the first sample with the pre-sample initialized estimator values.
requirements.why_checkable: Choosing initial values and a first sample with distinct values exposes whether old state was blended into the reset.

requirements.quote:
Packets sent on other
   paths do not contribute RTT samples to the current path
requirements.condition: When packets sent on a path other than the current path are acknowledged
requirements.required_behavior: Exclude their RTT samples from the current path's RTT estimator.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not update the current path's latest_rtt, smoothed_rtt, or rttvar from other-path packets.
requirements.why_checkable: A multipath or migration test can acknowledge packets from the old path and verify that current-path estimator state is unchanged.

requirements.quote: smoothed_rtt = latest_rtt
requirements.condition: On the first RTT sample after initialization
requirements.required_behavior: Set smoothed_rtt equal to latest_rtt.
requirements.why_checkable: After a known first sample, smoothed_rtt can be checked for exact equality with latest_rtt.

requirements.quote: rttvar = latest_rtt / 2
requirements.condition: On the first RTT sample after initialization
requirements.required_behavior: Set rttvar equal to one half of latest_rtt.
requirements.why_checkable: After a known first sample, rttvar can be checked for exact equality with latest_rtt divided by two.

requirements.quote: adjusted_rtt = latest_rtt
requirements.condition: At the start of processing each subsequent RTT sample
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize adjusted_rtt to latest_rtt before conditionally applying acknowledgment-delay subtraction.
requirements.why_checkable: A sample that fails the subtraction condition should leave adjusted_rtt equal to latest_rtt.

requirements.quote:
if (latest_rtt >= min_rtt + ack_delay):
     adjusted_rtt = latest_rtt - ack_delay
requirements.condition: On a subsequent RTT sample when latest_rtt is at least min_rtt plus the selected ack_delay
requirements.required_behavior: Set adjusted_rtt to latest_rtt minus ack_delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave adjusted_rtt unadjusted when this condition is true.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary tests immediately below, at, and above min_rtt plus ack_delay verify the comparison and subtraction.

requirements.quote: smoothed_rtt = 7/8 * smoothed_rtt + 1/8 * adjusted_rtt
requirements.condition: On each subsequent RTT sample after adjusted_rtt has been determined
requirements.required_behavior: Update smoothed_rtt to seven eighths of its prior value plus one eighth of adjusted_rtt.
requirements.why_checkable: Known prior smoothed_rtt and adjusted_rtt values yield an exact expected update.

requirements.quote: rttvar_sample = abs(smoothed_rtt - adjusted_rtt)
requirements.condition: On each subsequent RTT sample after smoothed_rtt has been updated
requirements.required_behavior: Set rttvar_sample to the absolute difference between the updated smoothed_rtt and adjusted_rtt.
requirements.why_checkable: Known updated smoothed_rtt and adjusted_rtt values yield an exact expected absolute difference.

requirements.quote: rttvar = 3/4 * rttvar + 1/4 * rttvar_sample
requirements.condition: On each subsequent RTT sample after rttvar_sample has been computed
requirements.required_behavior: Update rttvar to three quarters of its prior value plus one quarter of rttvar_sample.
requirements.why_checkable: Known prior rttvar and rttvar_sample values yield an exact expected update.
